data.summary: In your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), this applies when you pick friendly **TANKBUSTAS**, **FLASH GITZ** or **BREAKA BOYZ** **to shoot**. For each attack, they may re-roll 1s on **[Hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)** if the shooter’s unit or that attack’s target is within **[objective](vsdata:core-rule/objectives)** range.
